title: Calvatis GmbH
description:
[manufacturer] Calvatis GmbH — a Ladenburg, Germany-based chemical manufacturer operating since the mid-20th century, specializing in industrial cleaning and disinfection products for the food & beverage, dairy, brewing, and pharmaceutical sectors. The company operates through subsidiaries in Austria (Wels), Switzerland (Zurich), France (Sarcelles), Netherlands, Croatia/Adriatic, and maintains operations across 12+ international locations including Poland, UK, Hungary, Italy, and Spain.

The dataset comprises approximately 693 GB exfiltrated from corporate file servers, capturing IT infrastructure, HR, finance, R&D, production, sales, legal, and executive data across every business function and every international subsidiary:

<redacted>

<redacted>

Complete product formulation recipes for 15+ product lines (bioSanity, bioSol, bioTop I/IV, clean, Handwaschpaste, Lipophil, microClean, N-X, odoActive, StrawSil, and biogas products) representing the company's core trade secrets, 55+ product pricing and cost calculation files revealing full margin structures, Coca-Cola product approval documentation plus qualification data for 13 major OEM partners (Tetra Pak, Krones, KHS, Elopak, SIG Combibloc, Pentair, Sidel, Ecolean, Alpma, Paques, Radix, Munk&Schmitz), CRM database exports for the Adriatic subsidiary through 2026, and 500+ Access databases spanning contact management, LIMS, invoicing, and revenue tracking.

Audited annual financial statements (FY2021), quarterly management accounts through Q2 2026, IT asset inventories for all 12+ international locations, the complete CCU (Cleaning-in-Place Control Unit) C# source code repository with SQL injection vulnerability, 120+ Outlook PST email archives, AEO-C customs certification documentation, and 36 RDP configuration files exposing Active Directory usernames and internal server names.
